content:
For each fixed first digit \(a\) and last digit \(b\), the contribution is:
- one two-digit number: \(a-b\)
- ten three-digit numbers: \(10(a-b)\)
- one-digit number only when \(a=b\), contributing \(a-a=0\)

So total contribution per pair \((a,b)\) is \(11(a-b)\).

Sum over \(a=1,\dots,9\), \(b=0,\dots,9\):

\[
11\sum_{a=1}^9\sum_{b=0}^9 (a-b)
=11\sum_{a=1}^9 (10a - 45)
\]

\[
=11(10\cdot 45 - 9\cdot 45)
=11(450-405)
=11\cdot 45
=495
\]

\[
\boxed{495}
\]
